patch.value: GH-1583: recognize concrete private home paths through bounded shared normalization

The public detector-coverage report exposes platform and representation gaps in shared preflight. Recognize concrete private home coordinates at one shared matching boundary while preserving portable references, redacted diagnostics and existing guard modes. This is detection-only and does not make direct SDK persistence automatically guarded.

Recognize native POSIX, macOS, Windows, UNC and file-URL private home paths in the shared detector; Use bounded percent, escaped-slash and documented Unicode views while retaining original repository line locations; Keep portable aliases and non-private paths clear and preserve off, advise, block, force and scan-failure semantics; Return only safe typed normalization provenance and deterministic redacted findings; Prove pre-fix failure and legitimate controls through shared SDK/repository matching and guarded adapters

Concrete private profile paths are detected consistently by SDK preflight and tracked-file scanning across supported platforms and documented representations, without rewriting content or rejecting portable references.
